observed_limitations: Disk-full behavior is proven with injected ENOSPC at each durable stage, not by filling a real volume; C28 must measure the supported host.
OIDC identity, expired/replayed identity, session/step-up, forged headers and provider scope widening are not implemented or certified here; C08-C11 own them.
The port stores bounded metadata documents only. Plaintext secret redaction across logs, databases, traces and browser storage remains C13-C15.
No engine HTTP route or browser UI consumes the port yet; C12-C15 wiring and C29 readiness remain pending.
Cross-owner/scope reads return NOT_FOUND rather than a distinct SCOPE_DENIED code to avoid leaking name existence; the lookup key still includes owner and scope.

Manual deletion of the highest manifest file is not detectable by version discovery alone and would select the next manifest; interrupted commits cannot produce that state because rename is atomic. Operators must retain every accepted manifest and its blobs.
The exclusive lock uses Unix advisory flock and the supported profile is Linux x86_64; other host profiles are not certified.
The 256-entry operation window can evict very old replay entries; an update then fails the optimistic version check instead of silently duplicating.
